files.rationale: Combined both sides into one compilable transformer: B's typed PG13 imports, CallStmt, context-aware ObjectWithArgs/Drop/Comment/Cast/Grant handlers, SelectStmt sortClause/limitOffset/limitCount fields and SQL-syntax funcformat detection, plus A's PG13-to-PG14 A_Const, cleanTypeNameFields, TypeCast/ColumnDef/Constraint/CreateFunctionStmt/DefElem, runtime-schema helpers and rewritten transformDefault (which already covers B's CreateTableAsStmt relkind rename); the duplicate FuncCall, FunctionParameter and TypeName methods were each merged into a single definition (FuncCall keeps B's funcformat logic plus A's `over` handling, TypeName keeps B's recursive child transform plus A's location/typemod removal).
